summary.overview: The Onboarding and Strategy Meeting between Amanda and Andrew focused on establishing a collaborative foundation for their lead management efforts. After resolving initial technical issues, they introduced their respective roles and set up a Fireflies account for meeting transcription. Andrew provided an overview of the Close CRM system, emphasizing the organization of leads in various stages and identifying the SkyView Hit List as a primary focus. They discussed the email outreach strategy utilizing the Instantly platform, where automated cold email sequences are managed through shared inboxes for effective team communication. Amanda's tasks moving forward include reviewing specific lead columns in the CRM, conducting initial screening calls, and ensuring at least one qualified lead is booked for Jeff's calendar by their next meeting. Andrew will assist by adding Amanda to relevant communication channels and involving her in screening processes.
